IGUI_CA_JournalEmpty: No mission offered or under way.
IGUI_CA_TimeLeft: Game time left: %1 min at normal speed.
IGUI_CA_ReportHint: Objective met: report to the requester to complete the mission.
IGUI_CA_State_toReport: Objective met — to report to the requester
IGUI_CA_Mission_Clear: Clearing the surroundings of a place
IGUI_CA_NotebookHint: Open the notebook: contacts, missions, reputation and the pages of your mods.
IGUI_CA_ReputationUnavailable: Your reputation is not known yet: open the notebook once your character is in the world.
IGUI_CA_RepNoActs: Nothing remembered yet: your acts will make your reputation.
IGUI_CA_Error_MandateOwner: Only the current faction owner can designate or withdraw negotiators.
IGUI_CA_Error_MandateMember: This player is no longer a member of your faction.
IGUI_CA_Error_MandateFull: Negotiator limit reached: withdraw a mandate first.
IGUI_CA_Error_State: State changed or action unavailable. Refresh the notebook and confirm again.
IGUI_CA_DeliverEmpty: No item asked for in your inventory.
IGUI_CA_ClaimHint: Go back to the requester to collect the reward.
IGUI_CA_DeliverHint: Hand the items over next to the requester.
IGUI_CA_Error_Range: Requester missing, too far, on another floor or out of sight.
IGUI_CA_Error_Items: Insufficient, moved, favourite, equipped or inadmissible items. No transfer validated.
IGUI_CA_Error_Storage: Server storage unavailable: interactions blocked. Preserve files for diagnosis.
IGUI_CA_Error_Recovery: Interrupted exchange: administrator review required. Transaction blocked to prevent duplication; preserve inventories and logs.
IGUI_CA_Error_Capacity: Not enough inventory capacity for the shared reward.
IGUI_CA_Error_TooMany: Too many items: fewer are enough to cover what is still needed. Nothing was transferred.
IGUI_CA_Error_SupplyClosed: The group no longer needs this (offer filled or expired). Nothing was transferred.
IGUI_CA_Error_SupplyRefused: The group refused this delivery. Nothing was transferred.
IGUI_CA_Error_WrongCard: This is not the ID card taken from the body. Nothing was transferred.
IGUI_CA_ScoutNotReached: Place not reached yet. Ask the requester for directions; no coordinates are given.
IGUI_CA_ScoutReached: Place reached (%1). Report to the requester in person.
IGUI_CA_ScoutReport: Report: once the place has been reached, go back to the requester and tell them what you saw (Talk), or use Report next to them.
IGUI_CA_ScoutMapZone: An approximate area is circled on your map: the place is somewhere inside, not at its centre.
IGUI_CA_RetrieveMapZone: An approximate area is circled on your map: the body lies in the building, somewhere inside the area, not at its centre.
IGUI_CA_RetrieveNotFound: ID card not found yet. Search the building for the body; no coordinates are given.
IGUI_CA_RetrieveFound: ID card found (%1). Bring it back to the requester.
IGUI_CA_RetrieveReport: Hand-over: near the requester, select Deliver and choose the card taken from the body. Any other ID card is refused.
IGUI_CA_ClearMapZone: The area to clear is circled on your map, around the place: only zombies killed inside the circle count.
IGUI_CA_ClearProgress: Shared count: %1 / %2 zombies killed in the area
IGUI_CA_ClearRule: Only kills by participants count, with a weapon or a vehicle they drive. Zombies that die burning without a recent blow do not count, nor do survivors.
IGUI_CA_ClearReport: Once the count is reached, go back to the requester and tell them (Talk, or Report next to them): the mission succeeds then. Then collect the shared reward near them.
IGUI_CA_RecoverMapZone: An approximate area is circled on your map: the bag lies in the building, somewhere inside the area, not at its centre.
IGUI_CA_RecoverNotFound: Bag not found yet. Search the building; no coordinates are given.
IGUI_CA_RecoverFound: Bag found (%1). Carry it to the depot.
IGUI_CA_RecoverDepotZone: The depot of the group is circled on your map.
IGUI_CA_RecoverReport: Drop the bag on the floor inside the depot circle, or put it in a container there. Any other bag does not count. Once it is there, tell the requester (Talk, or Report next to them): the mission succeeds then. Then collect the shared reward near them.
IGUI_CA_SignalMapZone: The signal area is circled on your map, around the place: the signal must be lit inside the circle.
IGUI_CA_BarricadeMapZone: The building is circled on your map.
IGUI_CA_BarricadeRule: Only the outside windows and doors of this building count, barricaded with planks or metal, from inside or outside; each opening counts once. Openings already barricaded when the mission started do not count, and a barricade removed again stops counting.
IGUI_CA_BarricadeReport: Once the count is reached, call the voice back on its frequency and tell them the place is secured: the mission succeeds then.
IGUI_CA_RelayMapZone: The place is circled on your map.
IGUI_CA_RelayLevel: Put the radio on level %1 or higher (the ground is level 0): an upper floor or the roof.
IGUI_CA_RelayRule: Any radio that can transmit counts (walkie-talkie or ham radio), placed in the building of the place (or in the area around it when it has none), turned on and powered by its battery, the grid or a generator. A radio turned off, without power or taken away stops counting.
IGUI_CA_RelayReport: While it is on, call the voice back on its frequency and tell them the relay is up: the mission succeeds then.
IGUI_CA_WatchMapZone: The watch post is circled on your map.
IGUI_CA_WatchProgress: Time watched: %1 game minutes of %2 game hours.
IGUI_CA_WatchRule: Stay within %1 tiles of the place (an upper floor or the roof counts too): the time counts in game hours while someone of the mission is there. Leaving for more than %2 game minutes starts the watch again from zero.
IGUI_CA_WatchReport: Once the watch is done, call the voice back on its frequency and tell them what you saw: the mission succeeds then.
IGUI_CA_RouteMapZone: The next point is circled on your map; each point crossed stays circled.
IGUI_CA_RouteRule: Go through each circle, on foot or by vehicle, in the given order: a point reached before the previous one does not count and must be crossed again in its turn.
IGUI_CA_RouteReport: Once every point is crossed, call the voice back on its frequency and tell them: the mission succeeds then.
IGUI_CA_ItemMapZone: The place is circled on your map: the item lies on the floor somewhere inside.
IGUI_CA_ItemDropIt: Leave it at one of the drop points of the mission, at your choice.
IGUI_CA_ItemOnlyThis: Only the item put there for the voice counts: another item of the same kind is never taken.
IGUI_CA_ItemReport: Once it has been collected, call the voice back on its frequency: the mission succeeds then.
IGUI_CA_SignalHour: Light it between %1:00 and %2:00 (game time), any day before the deadline.
IGUI_CA_SignalRule: Only a smoke grenade, a road flare or a chemlight of the asked colour lit by a participant counts. Road flares are always red.
IGUI_CA_SignalReport: Once the signal is lit, go back to the requester and tell them (Talk, or Report next to them): the mission succeeds then. Then collect the shared reward near them.
IGUI_CA_OneUnit: One clean piece per unit; equivalents may be mixed. Favourite or equipped items excluded.
IGUI_CA_SupplyValues: Each item counts for its value (in brackets); types may be mixed. Only the last item may exceed what is still needed. Favourite or equipped items excluded.
IGUI_CA_RelayOn: A powered radio is on at the spot: yes.
IGUI_CA_RelayOff: A powered radio is on at the spot: no.
IGUI_CA_Clue_BuiltUp: It is in a built-up street, among many houses.
IGUI_CA_Clue_FewHouses: There are a few other houses around it.
IGUI_CA_Clue_Isolated: It stands on its own, with no other house close by.
IGUI_CA_Clue_LandmarkNext: There is %1 right next to it, %2.
IGUI_CA_Clue_NoLandmark: There is no shop or public building nearby.
IGUI_CA_Clue_TownCountry: It is out in the country, some way from %1.
IGUI_CA_Clue_TownFar: It is out in the countryside, far from any town.
IGUI_CA_Clue_TownOutskirts: It is on the outskirts of %1.
IGUI_CA_ConfirmAbandon:
Close this mission for all participants?
Every participant's reputation drops as for a failure; delivered supplies are not refunded.
IGUI_CA_ConfirmAccept:
Accept the displayed fixed terms?
The shared timer starts at the first acceptance and is never extended.
IGUI_CA_ConfirmDelivery:
Deliver %1 piece(s) to %2? %3 units were still needed.
The server will revalidate items, time and progress. No refund.
IGUI_CA_ConfirmSupply:
Deliver %1 item(s) worth %4 value points to %2?
%3 points were still needed.
The server will revalidate items, time and progress. No refund.
IGUI_CA_Empty_Missions: No known offer. Speak to a selected NPC from the Contacts page (or the local chat in multiplayer).
IGUI_CA_Error_Bridge: Unable to send to the bridge.
IGUI_CA_Error_Chat: The server rejected this dialogue due to chat restrictions or the word filter.
IGUI_CA_Error_Identity: Character identity not confirmed. Please wait.
IGUI_CA_Error_NoAnswer: Bridge missing, invalid or expired reply. No decision applied.
IGUI_CA_Error_NpcRange: NPC missing, out of range, on another floor or obscured. Selection cleared.
IGUI_CA_Error_Session: Server session changed. Reconnect the notebook.
IGUI_CA_Error_Text: Empty, too long or control characters in speech.
IGUI_CA_JoinRequester: Join the requester to make an exchange.
IGUI_CA_MissionState_cancelled_closed: Closed: the group no longer needs it (offer filled or expired), no mission penalty
IGUI_CA_MissionState_cancelled_dead: Cancelled — requester died, no mission penalty
IGUI_CA_MissionState_toReport: Objective met — to report to the requester
IGUI_CA_NoContactsSelect: No contacts. Ctrl+G near an NPC selects the nearest visible one; configurable in Options.
IGUI_CA_NoNPCProvider: No NPC engine active: the notebook has no interlocutor yet. Walt radio remains available.
IGUI_CA_NoRefund: Fixed terms. Personal acceptance. Partial deliveries are never refunded. Failure and abandonment have the same planned penalty.
IGUI_CA_ReportInPerson: Objective met: go back to %1 and tell them (Talk), or use Report next to them. The mission succeeds only then; the deadline still runs.
IGUI_CA_RewardGoodwill: No item offered in return: the group will remember your help.
IGUI_CA_RewardInformation: Reward: information from the voice (a place marked on your map, if it still has one to share).
IGUI_CA_RewardShared: Fixed shared reward: %1 × %2. One claim, free sharing.
IGUI_CA_TalkDead: Deceased: they can no longer answer.
IGUI_CA_TalkOutOfRange: Out of range: join them to speak (same floor, in sight).
IGUI_CA_TalkSelectFirst: Select this contact with Talk (or Ctrl+G nearby) to speak to them.
IGUI_CA_Time: Game time left: %1 min at normal speed. Stops while the game is paused.
IGUI_CA_UseChat: Target in range. Write on the Say line below (in multiplayer the local /say chat also works).
